results.note: De laude flagellorum et disciplinae ('In Praise of Flagellation'). No English translation found in searches despite mentions of the work in secondary literature.
De novissimis et Antichristo. No English translation located in comprehensive search of Peter Damian translations.
De officio principis in coercitione improborum. No English translation found despite targeted searches.
De ordine eremitarum et facultatibus eremi Fontis Avellani (Opusculum 14). Verified in Latin at Documenta Catholica Omnia but no English translation evidence found.
De patientia in insectatione improborum. No English translation located.
De perfecta informatione monachi. No English translation found in searches.

De perfectione monachorum (On the Perfection of Monks, Opusculum 13 / Letter 153). Translated by Patricia McNulty in 'St Peter Damian: Selected Writings on the Spiritual Life' (Harper & Brothers, 1959; London: Faber & Faber). Also included in Fathers of the Church Medieval Continuation letters series.
De picturis principum apostolorum. No English translation found.
De quadragesima et quadraginta duabus mansionibus Hebraeorum. No English translation located.
De sacramentis per improbos administratis. No English translation found.
De sancta simplicitate scientiae inflanti anteponenda. No English translation evidence found.
De spiritualibus deliciis. No English translation located.
De tempore celebrandi nuptias. No English translation found.
De variis miraculosis narrationibus. No English translation evidence found.
De variis sacris quaestionibus. No English translation located.

De vera felicitate ac sapientia (Concerning True Happiness and Wisdom, Opusculum 58). Translated by Patricia McNulty in 'St Peter Damian: Selected Writings on the Spiritual Life' (Harper & Brothers, 1959; London: Faber & Faber).
De vili vestitu ecclesiasticorum. No English translation found.
De vita eremitica et probatis eremitis (Opusculum 51). Verified in Latin at Documenta Catholica Omnia; no English translation found despite references to eremitical themes in his works.
Dialogus inter Judaeum et Christianum ad Honestum. No English translation located.
Disceptatio synodalis inter advocatum regis et defensorem Romanae ecclesiae. No English translation found.
Dissertatiuncula. No English translation evidence found.
Expositio mystica historiarum Libri Geneseos. No English translation located.

Hymnus de gloria Paradisi (The Glory of Paradise / De gloria Paradisi). English translations: Herbert Kynaston (1857, face-page Latin-English) and Athanasius Diedrich Wackerbarth (1843, in Lyra Ecclesiastica 2nd series). Both pre-1923, hence public domain.

Institutio monialis. No complete English translation found; a partial translation of 'De die mortis' section appeared in 'Mediaeval Hymns and Sequences' (3rd ed., London 1867), but full work not translated.
Invectio in episcopum monachos ad saeculum revocantem. No English translation located.

Liber Dominus vobiscum ad Leonem (The Book of 'The Lord be with you', Opusculum 11). Translated by Patricia McNulty in 'St Peter Damian: Selected Writings on the Spiritual Life' (Harper & Brothers, 1959; London: Faber & Faber).

Liber Gomorrhianus ad Leonem IX (Book of Gomorrah). Multiple modern copyrighted English translations: Pierre J. Payer (1982, Wilfred Laurier University Press); Owen J. Blum (1990s, in Fathers of the Church series); Matthew Cullinan Hoffman (2015, Ite ad Thomam).

Liber gratissimus ad Henricum Ravennatem. Included in Fathers of the Church Medieval Continuation Letters series (Owen J. Blum translator). As part of the complete letter collection (Letters 1-180), covered by FOTC copyrighted translations.

Acta (Life/acts of Peter Damian). Likely included in the Fathers of the Church medieval continuation series as biographical material accompanying the letter collection; however, verification of specific inclusion could not be confirmed through available sources.
